# awscc_securityhub_action_target (Resource)

Creates a custom action target in Security Hub.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action_target_id` (String) The ID for the custom action target. Can contain up to 20 alphanumeric characters.
- `description` (String) The description for the custom action target.
- `name` (String) The name of the custom action target. Can contain up to 20 characters.

### Read-Only

- `action_target_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the custom action target.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_securityhub_action_target.example
  identity = {
    action_target_arn = "action_target_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `action_target_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the custom action target

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_securityhub_action_target.example
  id = "action_target_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_securityhub_action_target.example "action_target_arn"
```
